function getCrawlableImage(image) {
  if (typeof image !== 'string') return undefined;

  const value = image.trim();

  if (!value || value.startsWith('data:')) {
    return undefined;
  }

  return value;
}

const normalizeIndonesianWhatsApp = (value) => {
  const digits = String(value || '').replace(/\D/g, '');

  if (digits.startsWith('62')) return digits;
  if (digits.startsWith('0')) return `62${digits.slice(1)}`;
  if (digits.startsWith('8')) return `62${digits}`;

  return digits;
};

const isLikelyValidIndonesianWhatsApp = (value) => {
  const normalized = normalizeIndonesianWhatsApp(value);

  // Nomor seluler Indonesia setelah normalisasi harus diawali 628.
  // Panjang total yang diterima: 11-14 digit.
  if (!/^628[1-9]\d{7,10}$/.test(normalized)) {
    return false;
  }

  const tail = normalized.slice(3);

  // Tolak nomor dengan digit akhir yang sama semua, misalnya 081111111111.
  if (/^(\d)\1{7,}$/.test(tail)) {
    return false;
  }

  // Tolak pola dummy yang sangat umum dipakai untuk mengakali form.
  const obviousDummyNumbers = new Set([
    '12345678',
    '123456789',
    '1234567890',
    '12345678901',
    '98765432',
    '987654321',
    '9876543210',
    '98765432109',
    '00000000',
    '000000000',
    '0000000000',
  ]);

  return !obviousDummyNumbers.has(tail);
};

const logLeadMagnetEvent = (eventName, name, whatsapp) => {
  if (!eventName || !whatsapp) return;

  const params = new URLSearchParams();

  params.append('action', 'event');
  params.append('event', eventName);
  params.append('name', String(name || '').trim());
  params.append('whatsapp', String(whatsapp || '').trim());
  params.append('source', 'umkmnaikkelas.id - Checklist Diagnosis 10 Medan');
  params.append('page', window.location.href);

  fetch(LEAD_ENDPOINT, {
    method: 'POST',
    mode: 'no-cors',
    body: params,
    keepalive: true,
  }).catch((error) => {
    console.error('Lead magnet event logging error:', error);
  });
};

// Backend contract: SAFE #8/#9 (lead_email, event_email, waitlist).
const WAITLIST_HREF = '/?page=waitlist';
const FUNNEL_MEDAN = ['Pemasaran', 'Penjualan', 'Operasional', 'Keuangan', 'SDM', 'Digital', 'Produksi', 'Distribusi', 'Negosiasi', 'Ekspansi'];
const FUNNEL_UTM_KEYS = ['utm_source', 'utm_medium', 'utm_campaign', 'utm_content', 'utm_term'];

function readFunnelUtm() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return {};
  const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  return Object.fromEntries(FUNNEL_UTM_KEYS.map((key) => [key, params.get(key) || '']));
}

function waitlistHrefWithUtm() {
  const params = new URLSearchParams({ page: 'waitlist' });
  Object.entries(readFunnelUtm()).forEach(([key, value]) => { if (value) params.set(key, value); });
  return `/?${params.toString()}`;
}

function trackFunnel(eventName, payload = {}) {
  // Analytics failure must never break a form, a link, or a download.
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try { if (typeof window.fbq === 'function') window.fbq('trackCustom', eventName, payload); } catch (_) { /* optional */ }
  try { if (typeof window.gtag === 'function') window.gtag('event', eventName, payload); } catch (_) { /* optional */ }
}

async function sendFunnelForm(action, data) {
  const body = new URLSearchParams({
    action, ...data,
    source: action === 'waitlist' ? 'umkmnaikkelas.id - Waitlist Pendampingan' : 'umkmnaikkelas.id - Checklist Diagnosis 10 Medan',
    page: window.location.href,
    ...readFunnelUtm(),
  });
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timer = window.setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 30000);
  try {
    // Keep the deployed transport. Do not resend after a CORS/timeout failure:
    // the server could already have written the row.
    const response = await fetch(LEAD_ENDPOINT, {
      method: 'POST', mode: 'no-cors', body, signal: controller.signal,
    });
    // Opaque is NOT proof of a stored row or a sent email.
    if (response.type === 'opaque') return { confirmed: false };
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Server belum mengonfirmasi penyimpanan.');
    const result = await response.json();
    if (result.ok !== true || result.type !== action) {
      throw new Error(result.error || 'Server belum mengonfirmasi data ini.');
    }
    return { ...result, confirmed: true };
  } finally {
    window.clearTimeout(timer);
  }
}

function logFunnelEmailEvent(eventName, name, email) {
  if (!email) return;
  const body = new URLSearchParams({
    action: 'event_email', event: eventName, name, email,
    source: 'umkmnaikkelas.id - Checklist Diagnosis 10 Medan',
    page: window.location.href, ...readFunnelUtm(),
  });
  // Existing event contract; this request never gates navigation/download.
  fetch(LEAD_ENDPOINT, { method: 'POST', mode: 'no-cors', body, keepalive: true }).catch(() => {});
}

function downloadCurrentChecklist() {
  const encoded = CHECKLIST_PDF.split(',')[1];
  const bytes = Uint8Array.from(window.atob(encoded), (char) => char.charCodeAt(0));
  const objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([bytes], { type: 'application/pdf' }));
  const link = document.createElement('a');
  link.href = objectUrl;
  link.download = 'Checklist_Diagnosis_10_Medan_UMKM_Waitlist.pdf';
  document.body.appendChild(link);
  link.click();
  link.remove();
  window.setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl), 60000);
}

function UpdatedLeadMagnet() {
  const [state, setState] = React.useState({ sending: false, result: null, error: '', name: '', email: '' });
  const busy = React.useRef(false);
  const submit = async (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (busy.current) return;
    const form = event.currentTarget;
    if (!form.reportValidity()) return;
    const fd = new FormData(form);
    const name = String(fd.get('name') || '').trim();
    const email = String(fd.get('email') || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!name || !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email) || !fd.get('consent')) {
      setState((s) => ({ ...s, error: 'Isi nama, email yang valid, dan persetujuan terlebih dahulu.' }));
      return;
    }
    busy.current = true;
    setState({ sending: true, result: null, error: '', name, email });
    try {
      const result = await sendFunnelForm('lead_email', { name, email, consent: 'true' });
      setState({ sending: false, result, error: '', name, email });
      trackFunnel('LeadMagnetOptIn', { submission_status: result.confirmed ? 'confirmed' : 'sent_unverified', ...readFunnelUtm() });
    } catch (_) {
      setState({ sending: false, result: null, name, email, error: 'Pengiriman belum dapat dipastikan. Isian tetap tersimpan di form. Periksa koneksi atau konfirmasikan melalui WhatsApp sebelum mengirim ulang.' });
    } finally { busy.current = false; }
  };
  const openWaitlist = () => {
    trackFunnel('WaitlistOpen', readFunnelUtm());
    logFunnelEmailEvent('WaitlistOpen', state.name, state.email);
  };
  return (
    <section id="checklist-gratis" className="bg-white px-5 py-16 sm:py-20">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-[72rem] overflow-hidden rounded-3xl border border-black/10 bg-[hsl(var(--ink))] text-white shadow-xl">
        <div className="grid gap-8 p-6 sm:p-10 lg:grid-cols-[1.15fr_0.85fr] lg:items-center lg:p-12">
          <div>
            <p className="text-xs font-extrabold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-[hsl(var(--gold))]">Checklist Diagnosis 10 Medan UMKM</p>
            <h2 className="mt-4 font-display text-3xl leading-tight sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl">Temukan 3 Medan Terlemah Usaha Anda dalam 5 Menit</h2>
            <p className="mt-5 text-sm leading-relaxed text-neutral-300 sm:text-base">Ketahui bagian usaha yang paling perlu diperbaiki, pilih tiga prioritas, lalu susun rencana aksi 7 hari. Diagnosis dulu, strategi kemudian.</p>
            <div className="mt-6 grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 text-center sm:gap-3">
              {['± 5 menit', '10 medan bisnis', '3 prioritas'].map((label) => <div key={label} className="rounded-xl bg-white/5 px-2 py-4 text-xs font-bold ring-1 ring-white/10 sm:text-sm">{label}</div>)}
            </div>
            <form id="lead-email-form" onSubmit={submit} className="mt-7 space-y-4">
              <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
                <div><label htmlFor="lead-name" className="mb-2 block text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">Nama</label><input id="lead-name" name="name" required maxLength={100} autoComplete="name" disabled={state.sending} className="w-full min-w-0 rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-white px-4 py-3 text-base text-neutral-900" /></div>
                <div><label htmlFor="lead-email" className="mb-2 block text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">Email</label><input id="lead-email" name="email" type="email" required maxLength={254} autoComplete="email" disabled={state.sending} className="w-full min-w-0 rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-white px-4 py-3 text-base text-neutral-900" /></div>
              </div>
              <label className="flex items-start gap-3 text-xs leading-relaxed text-neutral-300"><input type="checkbox" name="consent" required disabled={state.sending} className="mt-1 h-4 w-4 shrink-0" /><span>Saya setuju data digunakan untuk mengirim materi dan informasi pendampingan dari UMKM Naik Kelas. <Link to="/kebijakan-privasi" className="underline">Kebijakan privasi</Link>.</span></label>
              <button type="submit" disabled={state.sending || !!state.result} className="inline-flex min-h-[52px] w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-primary px-6 text-sm font-extrabold text-white disabled:opacity-60 sm:w-auto">{state.sending ? 'Mengirim...' : state.result ? 'Lihat checklist di bawah' : 'Kirim & Dapatkan Checklist'}</button>
              <p id="lead-submit-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" className="text-sm leading-relaxed text-neutral-300">{state.error}</p>
              {state.error && <a href={`https://wa.me/${WHATSAPP_CONFIRMATION_NUMBER}`} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="inline-block text-sm font-bold underline">Konfirmasi melalui WhatsApp</a>}
            </form>
            {state.result && <div id="lead-thankyou-panel" className="mt-6 rounded-2xl border border-white/15 bg-white/5 p-5">
              <h3 className="text-lg font-extrabold">Checklist siap diunduh</h3>
              <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-relaxed text-neutral-300">{state.result.confirmed ? 'Data Anda sudah tercatat. Unduh checklist, lalu tentukan 3 medan terendah Anda.' : 'Permintaan Anda telah dikirim. Checklist dapat diunduh di bawah ini; status penyimpanan dan email belum dapat dipastikan dari halaman ini.'}</p>
              <button id="lead-download-button" type="button" onClick={() => { try { downloadCurrentChecklist(); trackFunnel('LeadMagnetDownload', readFunnelUtm()); logFunnelEmailEvent('LeadMagnetDownload', state.name, state.email); } catch (_) { setState((s) => ({ ...s, error: 'Unduhan belum berhasil dibuka. Silakan coba sekali lagi.' })); } }} className="mt-4 inline-flex min-h-[48px] items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white px-6 text-sm font-bold text-neutral-900">Unduh Checklist PDF</button>
              <p className="mt-5 text-sm leading-relaxed">Ingin dibantu menyusun strategi 7 hari? Daftar waitlist pendampingan 3 slot.</p>
              <Link id="lead-waitlist-cta" to={waitlistHrefWithUtm()} onClick={openWaitlist} className="mt-3 inline-flex min-h-[48px] items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-primary px-6 text-sm font-extrabold text-white">Gabung Waitlist <ArrowRight className="h-4 w-4" /></Link>
            </div>}
            <p className="mt-6 text-sm text-neutral-300">Sudah mengisi checklist? <Link to={waitlistHrefWithUtm()} onClick={openWaitlist} className="font-bold text-white underline">Langsung daftar waitlist pendampingan.</Link></p>
          </div>
          <div className="rounded-3xl bg-[#fffaf3] p-7 text-neutral-900 sm:p-9">
            <p className="text-xs font-extrabold uppercase tracking-[0.15em] text-primary">Diagnosis dulu. Baru susun strategi.</p>
            <h3 className="mt-5 font-display text-3xl leading-tight sm:text-4xl">Checklist Diagnosis<br />10 Medan UMKM</h3>
            <p className="mt-5 text-sm leading-relaxed text-neutral-600">Pemasaran · Penjualan · Operasional · Keuangan · SDM · Digital · Produksi · Distribusi · Negosiasi · Ekspansi</p>
            <div className="my-6 border-l-4 border-primary pl-4 text-sm font-bold leading-relaxed">Bukan memperbaiki semuanya sekaligus. Temukan 3 prioritas paling penting.</div>
            <p className="font-display text-7xl text-[hsl(var(--gold))]">10</p>
            <p className="mt-2 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-neutral-500">Medan diagnosis · rencana aksi 7 hari</p>
            <p className="mt-5 text-sm leading-relaxed text-neutral-600">PDF mencakup rekap skor, rencana 7 hari, serta ajakan dan QR waitlist pada halaman terakhir.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div id="waitlist-pendampingan" className="mx-auto mt-8 max-w-[72rem] scroll-mt-28 rounded-2xl border border-primary/15 bg-[#fffaf3] p-6 sm:p-8">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-5 md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between">
          <div><p className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-primary">Pendampingan 4 minggu · online</p><h3 className="mt-2 font-display text-2xl sm:text-3xl">Daftar Waitlist Pendampingan UMKM — 3 Slot Terbatas September 2026</h3><p className="mt-2 max-w-2xl text-sm leading-relaxed text-neutral-600">Sudah tahu 3 medan terlemah, tetapi butuh bantuan agar rencana benar-benar jalan? Kirim hasil diagnosis dan target 30 hari Anda.</p></div>
          <Link to={waitlistHrefWithUtm()} onClick={openWaitlist} className="inline-flex min-h-[52px] shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-primary px-6 text-sm font-extrabold text-white">Saya Siap Dibantu <ArrowRight className="h-4 w-4" /></Link>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

function WaitlistUpdatedPage() {
  const [state, setState] = React.useState({ sending: false, result: null, error: '', whatsappUrl: '' });
  const busy = React.useRef(false);
  const submit = async (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (busy.current) return;
    const form = event.currentTarget;
    if (!form.reportValidity()) return;
    const fd = new FormData(form);
    const data = Object.fromEntries(['name', 'email', 'whatsapp', 'medan1', 'medan2', 'medan3', 'score1', 'score2', 'score3', 'problem', 'target30'].map((key) => [key, String(fd.get(key) || '').trim()]));
    data.email = data.email.toLowerCase();
    data.whatsapp = normalizeIndonesianWhatsApp(data.whatsapp);
    const medans = [data.medan1, data.medan2, data.medan3];
    const scores = [data.score1, data.score2, data.score3].map(Number);
    let error = '';
    if (!data.name || !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(data.email)) error = 'Masukkan nama dan email yang valid.';
    else if (!isLikelyValidIndonesianWhatsApp(data.whatsapp)) error = 'Nomor WhatsApp belum valid. Gunakan nomor aktif dengan awalan 08 atau +62.';
    else if (medans.some((m) => !FUNNEL_MEDAN.includes(m)) || new Set(medans).size !== 3) error = 'Pilih tiga medan yang berbeda.';
    else if (scores.some((score) => !Number.isInteger(score) || score < 4 || score > 12)) error = 'Setiap skor harus bilangan bulat 4–12, sesuai checklist.';
    else if (!data.problem || !data.target30 || !fd.get('consent')) error = 'Lengkapi masalah utama, target 30 hari, dan persetujuan.';
    if (error) { setState((s) => ({ ...s, error })); return; }
    data.consent = 'true';
    const summary = [`Halo UMKM Naik Kelas, saya ${data.name}.`, 'Saya ingin mengonfirmasi waitlist pendampingan.', ...medans.map((m, i) => `${i + 1}. ${m}: ${scores[i]}/12`), `Masalah utama: ${data.problem}`, `Target 30 hari: ${data.target30}`].join('\n');
    const whatsappUrl = `https://wa.me/${WHATSAPP_CONFIRMATION_NUMBER}?text=${encodeURIComponent(summary)}`;
    busy.current = true;
    setState({ sending: true, result: null, error: '', whatsappUrl });
    try {
      const result = await sendFunnelForm('waitlist', data);
      setState({ sending: false, result, error: '', whatsappUrl });
      trackFunnel('WaitlistSubmit', { submission_status: result.confirmed ? 'confirmed' : 'sent_unverified', ...readFunnelUtm() });
      if (result.confirmed) trackFunnel('WaitlistThankYou', { submission_status: 'confirmed', ...readFunnelUtm() });
    } catch (_) {
      setState({ sending: false, result: null, error: 'Pengiriman belum dapat dipastikan. Isian tidak dihapus. Konfirmasikan melalui WhatsApp sebelum mencoba lagi.', whatsappUrl });
    } finally { busy.current = false; }
  };
  return (
    <>
      <Helmet><title>Waitlist Pendampingan UMKM — 3 Slot September 2026</title><meta name="description" content="Daftar waitlist pendampingan UMKM 4 minggu untuk memperbaiki 3 medan terlemah hasil Diagnosis 10 Medan." /><link rel="canonical" href={`${SITE.url}${WAITLIST_HREF}`} /></Helmet>
      <div className="bg-[#fffaf3] text-neutral-900">
        <section className="bg-[#6f1515] px-5 py-12 text-white sm:py-16"><div className="mx-auto max-w-5xl"><Link to="/#checklist-gratis" className="text-sm text-red-100 underline">← Kembali ke checklist</Link><p className="mt-6 text-xs font-extrabold uppercase tracking-[0.15em] text-[hsl(var(--gold))]">Waitlist pendampingan · September 2026</p><h1 className="mt-4 max-w-4xl font-display text-3xl leading-tight sm:text-5xl">Daftar Waitlist Pendampingan UMKM — 3 Slot Terbatas September 2026</h1><p className="mt-5 max-w-3xl text-sm leading-relaxed text-red-50 sm:text-base">Untuk pemilik UMKM yang sudah diagnosis 10 medan, tahu 3 prioritas, tapi butuh pendampingan agar benar-benar jalan.</p></div></section>
        <section className="px-5 py-12 sm:py-16"><div className="mx-auto grid max-w-[72rem] gap-7 lg:grid-cols-2">
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <div className="rounded-2xl border border-black/10 bg-white p-6 sm:p-8"><h2 className="font-display text-2xl">Apa yang Anda dapatkan</h2><ul className="mt-4 list-disc space-y-3 pl-5 text-sm leading-relaxed text-neutral-700"><li>Sesi pendampingan 1-on-1 (online) selama 4 minggu.</li><li>Fokus pada 3 medan terlemah hasil checklist Anda.</li><li>Rencana aksi 7 hari yang spesifik, bukan teori.</li><li>Follow-up via WhatsApp setiap minggu.</li><li>Modul dari buku <em>100 Strategi Sun Tzu: UMKM Naik Kelas</em>.</li></ul></div>
            <div className="rounded-2xl border border-black/10 bg-white p-6 sm:p-8"><h2 className="font-display text-2xl">Untuk siapa</h2><ul className="mt-4 list-disc space-y-3 pl-5 text-sm leading-relaxed text-neutral-700"><li>Sudah mengisi Checklist Diagnosis 10 Medan.</li><li>Punya 3 medan dengan skor 4–6 (rawan).</li><li>Serius ingin memperbaiki dalam 30 hari.</li><li>Bukan untuk yang hanya ingin teori atau diskon.</li></ul></div>

              </fieldset>
              <div id="waitlist-submit-status" role="status" aria-live="polite" className="text-sm leading-relaxed text-neutral-700">{state.error}{state.result && <div className="rounded-xl border border-primary/15 bg-[#fffaf3] p-4"><strong>{state.result.confirmed ? Status penyimpanan dan email belum dapat dipastikan dari halaman ini.'}</p></div>}</div>

      </div>
    </>
  );
}

export default function HomePage() {
  const location = useLocation();
  const isWaitlist = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('page') === 'waitlist';
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (isWaitlist) window.scrollTo(0, 0);
    else if (location.hash) {
      const id = location.hash.slice(1);
      const frame = window.requestAnimationFrame(() => document.getElementById(id)?.scrollIntoView());
      return () => window.cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
    }
    return undefined;
  }, [isWaitlist, location.hash]);
  // Routing remains within the existing / route; App.jsx is untouched.
  return isWaitlist ? <WaitlistUpdatedPage /> : <HomePageContent />;
}
